text:
alex: anyone else see alerts but no pages? spike of 5xx from prod-canary started ~10m ago, nothing paged to PD :thinking:
incidentbot: automatic suppression engaged for channel #incidents (reason: recent manual mute). suppressed_count=3 until=1725032400 :no_entry:
jamie: omg, we had suppression enabled during deploy window. @oncall_jordan are you oncall? you should have been paged.
oncall_jordan: oncall_jordan: I did not get a page. I only saw alex's message. I'm available, going to jump in.
sre_kyle: looking at logs — incidentbot POST -> notify-proxy returned 500 repeatedly. incidentbot treated the 500 as transient and incremented suppression state (bug), it should have retried or escalate. here's log snippet:
```
2024-03-17T21:01:12Z incidentbot POST /notify -> 500 {"error":"upstream"}
2024-03-17T21:01:12Z incidentbot set_suppression channel:#incidents reason:upstream-error
```
megan: digging on notify-proxy — upstream pagerflow was returning 502 during a config reload. proxy returned 502 + no Retry-After. incidentbot's code path uses absence of Retry-After to assume "no page needed" and increments suppressed counter. bad heuristic.
jamie: manual escalation now — paging PD and calling the oncall rotation. someone run /pd trigger please.
alex: /pd incident create --service=prod-alerts --summary="High 5xx rate in prod-canary, no auto-pages delivered" --urgency=high
oncall_jordan: got the manual PD page at 1725032260 and started mitigation. rolling back canary and scaling up notify-proxy pool.
sre_kyle: i restarted notify-proxy on eu-cluster (systemctl restart notify-proxy) — health checks returning 200 now. rechecked incidentbot queue: 3 suppressed pages pending.
incidentbot: recovered: requeued 3 suppressed alerts, delivered to PD at 1725032360 :white_check_mark:
megan: customer impact: error-rate bump ~4% affecting ~1.2k requests over 12m in eu-west. a handful of customers on heavy batch jobs saw failures (we have 2 support pings so far). no global SLO breach yet, but blips.
alex: ops mitigation: rollback completed at 1725032305, proxy scaled x2, pages delivered. Confirmed routing fixed.
jamie: immediate actions: 1) hotfix incidentbot heuristic to not treat 5xx as suppression trigger; 2) add metric alert for "suppressed_pages>0 when critical_alerts>0"; 3) runpostmortem and notify affected customers. assign owners?
megan: i'll own the proxy scaling and metric addition. create a ticket.
oncall_jordan: i'll own the postmortem and customer comms. tagging eng-sre for follow-up.
alex: thanks everyone. final note: if you see alerts and no pages, ping ops+oncall directly; incidentbot has been reverted to safe-mode until patch is deployed. :handshake:

ACTION ITEMS:
- MEGAN: ticket # (create) — add suppressed_pages metric + alert
- SRE_KYLE: submit PR to incidentbot to change suppression heuristic
- ONCALL_JORDAN: lead postmortem and customer impact note
- JAMIE: verify rollback playbook and schedule canary config freeze window

(threads: short, we paged manually, mitigations in place, follow-up retro scheduled)
